title: Compatible algebraization without a torsion hypothesis
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $I,K$ be quasi-coherent ideal sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-ideal-closed-subscheme], let $M$ be a coherent $I$-adic system [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and let $H$ be a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent]. For each $q\geq1$, assume completion on $V(K^q)$ with respect to the extended ideal $I\mathcal O_{V(K^q)}$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal] is an equivalence, for every choice of its Noetherian instance. Let $\alpha:M\to\widehat H_I$. Supply a natural isomorphism $\theta_{e,n}:(H/K^{e+1}H)/I^{n+1}\cong(H/I^{n+1}H)/K^{e+1}$ whose composite with the successive quotient projections agrees in both orders, for every $e,n\geq0$. Then there exist a coherent $K$-adic system $N$, a morphism $\delta:N\to\widehat H_K$, and a natural isomorphism $\sigma_{e,n}:N_e/I^{n+1}N_e\cong M_n/K^{e+1}M_n$ such that $\sigma_{e,n}$ followed by $\alpha_n$ modulo $K^{e+1}$ equals $\delta_e$ modulo $I^{n+1}$ followed by $\theta_{e,n}$, for all $e,n\geq0$. No annihilation hypothesis on $\alpha$ is assumed and no torsion estimate on $\delta$ is asserted.

proof.text: For each e, form the coherent I-adic quotient system M_n/K^(e+1)M_n. On affine opens its coherence is finite generation of a quotient and its I-adic transition identities are successive quotient identities. Descend this supported system to Z_e=V(K^(e+1)) using the closed-immersion formal equivalence. Apply a quasi-inverse of the assumed completion equivalence, then coherent pushforward, to obtain G_e and its comparison with the quotient system. The equivalence determines the algebraization together with the comparison up to unique isomorphism.

The I-completion of G_(e+1)/K^(e+1)G_(e+1) is the level-e quotient system, by the equality of successive quotients and the canonical projection identities. Full faithfulness on Z_e identifies this quotient with G_e. Compose the quotient projection with this isomorphism to define the adjacent transition; define longer transitions by composition. Faithfulness proves that the comparisons commute with these transitions. Coherence, annihilation and the adjacent quotient isomorphisms give N in Coh(X,K). The comparisons assemble into the doubly natural sigma.

Reduce alpha modulo K^(e+1), then compose with theta inverse. Naturality makes it an I-adic morphism from completion_I(G_e) to completion_I(H/K^(e+1)H). Both terms descend to Z_e. Full faithfulness of completion on Z_e uniquely lifts it to delta_e. Faithfulness proves transition compatibility, so the delta_e form delta. Their lifted defining equations are precisely the stated comparison square. The projection identity on theta specifies the canonical quotient interchange.

theorem grothendieckDevissage_secondAdicSystem_lift
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (M : CoherentFormalModule X I)
    (hthick : ∀ (e : ℕ), 1 ≤ e →
      ∀ (hZ : IsNoetherian (K ^ e).subscheme),
        Functor.IsEquivalence
          (@completion ((K ^ e).subscheme) hZ (I.comap (K ^ e).subschemeι)))
    (H : CoherentModules X) (α : M ⟶ (completion X I).obj H)
    (θ : formalCompletionSystem K H.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor I ≅
      (formalCompletionSystem I H.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor K).flip)
    (hθ : ∀ e n : ℕ,
        formalModuleQuotientπ K (e + 1) H.obj ≫
          formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (formalModuleQuotient K (e + 1) H.obj) ≫
          (θ.hom.app (op e)).app (op n) =
        formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) H.obj ≫
          formalModuleQuotientπ K (e + 1) (formalModuleQuotient I (n + 1) H.obj)) :
    ∃ (N : CoherentFormalModule X K) (δ : N ⟶ (completion X K).obj H)
      (σ : N.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor I ≅
        (M.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor K).flip),
      ∀ e n : ℕ,
        (σ.hom.app (op e)).app (op n) ≫
          formalModuleQuotientMap K (α.hom.app (op n)) (Nat.le_refl (e + 1)) =
        formalModuleQuotientMap I (δ.hom.app (op e)) (Nat.le_refl (n + 1)) ≫
          (θ.hom.app (op e)).app (op n)
